knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A clean single-use applicator prevents the shared product from being contaminated by a used tool or a fingertip.
Leftover product is discarded, not returned to the shared container.
The Victorian Department of Health names the 2019 infection prevention and control guideline as the one make-up application businesses must follow.

practicalCriteria: Assessor observes the candidate take product from a shared pot with a clean single-use applicator and discard the leftover
Assessor checks the approved kit list records a source and a cleaning or single-use rule for each tool
evidenceRequired: Approved kit list with a source for each tool rule
Cleaning and disinfection record for reusable tools
stopWorkCriteria: A used tool is returned to a shared container
A reusable tool is used on a client without the recorded cleaning step
